cases.description: Create a bucket by rendering the Copier template, and keep rendered files separate from repository configuration.
cases.prompt: I want a new Scoop bucket for my team from the bucket template. What do I run and what else must I configure? This is a desk exercise: do not edit the repo, run installs, or perform network requests. No bucket checkout is available in this session, so do not search for one: answer from the skill's guidance and name the bucket files, scripts and workflow jobs you would inspect. Answer concretely.

rubric_items.text: Renders the template with copier copy and does not suggest GitHub's Use this template or gh repo create --template.
Asks for or confirms owner, repository, default branch and first package instead of inventing them.
Separates rendered files from settings, secrets, labels and apps that are not rendered and must be checked.
Hands the first manifest to scoop-add and scoop-verify rather than hand-writing JSON.

cases.description: Explain which credential the update workflows actually read.
cases.prompt: I created a SCOOP_BUCKET_TOKEN secret but update PRs don't trigger CI. What should I do? This is a desk exercise: do not edit the repo, run installs, or perform network requests. No bucket checkout is available in this session, so do not search for one: answer from the skill's guidance and name the bucket files, scripts and workflow jobs you would inspect. Answer concretely.

rubric_items.text: States that no workflow or script reads SCOOP_BUCKET_TOKEN and that WORKFLOW_TOKEN is the secret the update steps use, falling back to GITHUB_TOKEN.
Explains that GITHUB_TOKEN suppresses follow-on runs with exceptions, and checks the actual runs rather than assuming.
Does not request or print secret values and does not recommend blanket repo or admin privileges.

cases.description: A shim scaffolded in a fresh bucket is not installable until the noop script is published at the exact repository and ref.
cases.prompt: I rendered the template, scaffolded a PyPI shim and the checks pass locally, but scoop install fails to download. Why? This is a desk exercise: do not edit the repo, run installs, or perform network requests. No bucket checkout is available in this session, so do not search for one: answer from the skill's guidance and name the bucket files, scripts and workflow jobs you would inspect. Answer concretely.

rubric_items.text: Identifies that the shim's noop URL points at the bucket's repository and ref, which must publish the same LF bytes as the local scripts/noop.ps1.
Checks origin and SCOOP_BUCKET_REPOSITORY and SCOOP_BUCKET_REF overrides for stale values.
Does not replace the hash or point at the template to hide the mismatch, and keeps install evidence pending.
